name: Smith Machine Standing Calf Raise
steps: Rest the bar across your upper back and set your feet hip-width apart.
Release the hooks and brace with your knees slightly unlocked.
Drive upward through the balls of both feet to lift your heels as high as possible, squeezing your calves firmly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor before initiating the next repetition.
tips: Keep your knees stationary so your quads do not bounce the bar upward.
Pause briefly at the top of each calf raise to maximize calf tension.
